title: 走进生物风险管理

points.K1: 欢迎来到生物风险管理
points.K2: 新的职业：生物风险管理者
points.K3: 五周在线课程，系统学习
points.S1: 国内法规标准，心中有数
points.S2: 用过的针：不回套，直接入盒
points.S3: 楼内转运：密封盒装好再走
points.S4: 样本和实验信息，不随意透露

shots.scene: 欣欣站在电脑屏幕旁，屏幕上是空白的课程页面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a computer screen showing a blank online course page and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，带你走进生物风险管理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍用笔记本电脑浏览，屏幕上一个空白招生横幅
shots.prompt_en: The young male student browses on a laptop in a dorm; the screen shows a blank course banner with a microbe pictogram.
shots.narration: 阿杰刷到一门在线课，很感兴趣。

shots.scene: 阿杰转头问小研，头上冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns to ask the female graduate student, with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，到底管些什么？

shots.scene: 小研笑着在白板上画一个大圆圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and draws a big circle on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 小研说：咱们一起来看看。

shots.section_title: 欢迎来到生物风险管理
shots.scene: 一扇门打开，门内是整洁的实验室和各种安全图标
shots.prompt_en: A door opens to reveal a tidy lab with floating safety icons: gloves, a cabinet, a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，是一个专门的领域，
overlay: 欢迎来到生物风险管理

shots.section_title: 欢迎来到生物风险管理
shots.scene: 人、样本、实验室三个图标被一个圆环围住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person, a sample tube and a lab building enclosed by one protective ring. No people.
shots.narration: 目标是让人、样本和环境都安全。

shots.section_title: 新的职业：生物风险管理者
shots.scene: 王老师胸前挂着空白工牌，在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator wearing a blank badge walks through the lab with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 这个领域，正需要专门的管理者。
overlay: 新的职业：生物风险管理者

shots.section_title: 新的职业：生物风险管理者
shots.scene: 评估表、盾牌、培训课堂三个图标连成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a risk assessment form, a shield and a small classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 他们做评估、定措施、搞培训。

shots.section_title: 新的职业：生物风险管理者
shots.scene: 阿杰眼睛一亮，头上冒出一个灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's eyes light up with a light bulb above his head.
shots.narration: 这也可以是一条职业道路。

shots.section_title: 五周在线课程，系统学习
shots.scene: 一张五格日历，每格一个书本图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with five weekly boxes, each with a book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这门在线课共五周，免费开放，
overlay: 五周在线课程，系统学习

shots.section_title: 五周在线课程，系统学习
shots.scene: 阿杰戴耳机在电脑前做笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears headphones and takes notes in front of a laptop.
shots.narration: 可以一步步系统地学。

shots.scene: 两格对比：打翻的试管图标和上锁的样品柜
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a tipped-over tube icon on the left, a locked sample cabinet on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 课程讲两样：生物安全和生物安保。

shots.scene: 左格试管加上防护盾
shots.prompt_en: A shield appears over the tipped-over tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全，是防止意外暴露和泄漏；

shots.scene: 右格样品柜加上门禁和登记本
shots.prompt_en: An access card reader and a logbook appear next to the locked sample cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 安保，是防止丢失、被盗和滥用。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着桌上的样本管、针筒和利器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a table with icons of a capped sample tube, a syringe and a yellow sharps container.
shots.narration: 实验室里，风险源就在手边：

shots.scene: 戴手套的手稳稳拿着一支盖紧的样本管
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a tightly capped blank sample tube steadily. No people.
shots.narration: 血液等样本，可能带有病原；

shots.scene: 针头图标和一个小红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A syringe needle icon with a small red warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 针头锐器，可能刺伤皮肤；

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜内向孔板加样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pipettes into a multi-well plate inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 移液加样，可能产生气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 用过的针：不回套，直接入盒
shots.scene: 用过的针筒直接放进黄色利器盒
shots.prompt_en: A used syringe is placed directly into a yellow sharps container with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的针，直接放进利器盒。
overlay: 用过的针：不回套，直接入盒

shots.section_title: 用过的针：不回套，直接入盒
shots.scene: 双手回套针帽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands recapping a needle, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不回套针帽，不掰弯，不拆针头。

shots.section_title: 用过的针：不回套，直接入盒
shots.scene: 利器盒装到约四分之三处，盖子扣紧
shots.prompt_en: A sharps container about three quarters full with its lid being closed. No people.
shots.narration: 盒子别装太满，封好再交处置。

shots.section_title: 楼内转运：密封盒装好再走
shots.scene: 样本管放进带盖的密封转运盒
shots.prompt_en: Capped sample tubes placed upright in a rack inside a sealed transport box with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 样本在楼内转运，先装密封盒。
overlay: 楼内转运：密封盒装好再走

shots.section_title: 楼内转运：密封盒装好再走
shots.scene: 徒手拿着试管在走廊走动的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking in a corridor holding open tubes by hand, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不要手拿着试管在走廊里走。

shots.section_title: 楼内转运：密封盒装好再走
shots.scene: 阿杰双手捧着转运盒稳步走，旁边一卷吸水纸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a sealed transport box with both hands; absorbent paper is packed inside.
shots.narration: 盒里垫吸水材料，万一洒了也不外漏。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白报名页面点击提交按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks a blank submit button on a laptop screen.
shots.narration: 感兴趣，就报名，

shots.scene: 阿杰和其他学员在空白讨论区交流图标
shots.prompt_en: Chat bubble icons on a blank forum page, the young male student typing a question.
shots.narration: 跟着课程积极参与讨论。

shots.section_title: 国内法规标准，心中有数
shots.scene: 书架上几本空白书和一个国徽式样的印章图标
shots.prompt_en: A bookshelf with several blank books and an official stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 学在国外课程，也要对照国内要求：
overlay: 国内法规标准，心中有数

shots.section_title: 国内法规标准，心中有数
shots.scene: 两本空白标准册和一本目录
shots.prompt_en: Two blank standard booklets and one blank catalogue book on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 通用标准、通用准则和病原目录。

shots.section_title: 国内法规标准，心中有数
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的本校实验室手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank lab safety handbook.
shots.narration: 还有本校规定，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 样本和实验信息，不随意透露
shots.scene: 一个陌生人图标在打听，小研摆手拒绝
shots.prompt_en: A shadowy stranger icon asks a question; the female graduate student politely shakes her head.
shots.narration: 保藏了什么、放在哪里，不随便说。
overlay: 样本和实验信息，不随意透露

shots.section_title: 样本和实验信息，不随意透露
shots.scene: 手机拍样本柜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a phone photographing a sample freezer, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 样本柜和门禁，不拍照乱发。

shots.section_title: 样本和实验信息，不随意透露
shots.scene: 小研拿起电话，旁边保卫处值班员接听
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; the security officer answers at a desk.
shots.narration: 遇到可疑询问，告诉老师和保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三块空白牌子，上面分别是书、眼睛、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three blank signs with a book icon, an eye icon and a shield icon.
shots.narration: 最后记住三句话：

shots.scene: 书本图标发亮
shots.prompt_en: The book icon glows brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 持续了解新知识和新规定，

shots.scene: 眼睛图标和盾牌图标依次发亮
shots.prompt_en: The eye icon and then the shield icon glow brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 对异常保持警觉，守住生物安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁是课程页、样本管、利器盒和密封盒图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside icons of a course page, a sample tube, a sharps container and a sealed transport box.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，既管安全也管安保。

shots.scene: 针入利器盒、样本进密封盒的两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two checked icons: a needle going into a sharps container and tubes going into a sealed box. No people.
shots.narration: 针不回套，样本密封转运。

shots.scene: 法规书架、闭嘴手势和准入证图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a law bookshelf, a finger-on-lips gesture and a blank lab access card. No people.
shots.narration: 对照国内要求，信息不外传，先准入再进。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、王老师一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 学起来，用起来，下次见！
